'''Ladira''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Information broker/Legends|Information broker]], who operated in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. She pretended to be sympathetic to both the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], so that she could get business from both factions. After [[Momaw Nadon/Legends|Momaw Nadon]] was kidnapped by [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Centa Sonhan]], Ladira gave the Rebel Alliance the location of [[Centa Sonhan's sail barge]], where Nadon was being held. However, she didn't want to compromise her relations with the Empire, so she also arranged for some [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] to intercept the Rebels.
